name: happy_path_chunking
note: Two functions share a module-level constant; both get their own chunk and both list it in used_names.

name: happy_path_symbol_edge
note: After index.build against a disposable temp repo, a kind='symbol' edge connects train_step and evaluate both directions.

name: common_helper_trap_hub_suppressed
note: log_metrics is referenced by 8 chunks (itself + 7 callers) -- over HUB_NAME_FANOUT (5) -- so index.py must skip ALL symbol edges from that name.

expect.note: preamble + seed chunk only -- since HUB_NAME_FANOUT already suppressed log_metrics's symbol edges at index time, retrieve() never even has a neighbor to expand to. This is a stronger result than the original spec anticipated ("falls back to whole file"): the index-time fix keeps the pack minimal instead of needing the retrieve-time MAX_SYMBOL_FANOUT fallback to fire at all for this case.

name: param_binding_positive
note: A `replay_buffer` parameter case-normalizes to the module-level `ReplayBuffer` class even though it never appears as a plain Name load.

name: param_binding_negative_noise_filter
note: The unrelated `data` parameter must not resolve to anything -- used_names['train'] contains ReplayBuffer and nothing else.

name: shared_locals_only_no_edge
note: Both functions share only a same-named LOCAL variable (never module-level) -- used_names must be empty for both, so no symbol edge can ever form.

name: syntax_error_fallback
note: Deliberately broken Python must not crash is_chunking_candidate/build_chunks/extract_chunk -- falls back to whole-file inclusion.

name: sub_threshold_never_sliced
note: 3 small functions under the token threshold -- must stay one whole-file chunk even though the def count alone would otherwise qualify.

name: env_key_exclusion
note: os.getenv()/os.environ[...] sourced module-level assignments must not be treated as connective constants; a real constant still is.
